metrics.avoidable_owner_interruption_rate: owner interruptions classified as self-resolvable / total owner interruptions
metrics.maintenance_self_resolution_rate: maintenance events autonomously resolved / maintenance events
metrics.recovery_self_resolution_rate: recovery events autonomously resolved / recovery events
metrics.chat_dependency_rate: episodes requiring a new chat turn to continue / episodes
metrics.global_stall_rate: episodes where local provider/authority failure froze independent lanes / episodes
metrics.autonomy_debt: count of avoidable human scheduler / retry / repair / restatement patterns
